The Chinese characters for Louis

As a transliteration, Louis is usually written 路易斯 (Lù yì sī). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

路
Lù
road
易
yì
easy, change
斯
sī
this (transliteration)

Origin and meaning

From Germanic, Louis carries the meaning “famous warrior”.

About the name Louis

The name of many French kings, including the sainted Louis IX.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “famous warrior”, a Louis calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
